text:
Nora: Quick sync: propose a conservative lifecycle for cohort-C pins. Idea: single 60d grace default + an opt-in automated downgrader for low-touch tenants but with a strict fallback lane and billing reconciliation. Looking for quick takes.

Ken: From runtime, safe if we add a gradual trial: shadow 14d -> staged 72h taper -> monitor for KV cache churn. Need clear thresholds for token usage and regen spikes.

Sam: Ops notes: require per-tenant audit trail and an emergency hold flag that stops any automated change. Alerts: 99p latency + regen-error rate; threshold +10% and +2% respectively. One-click rollback required.

Ivy: Product acceptance asks: (1) canary bench delta <=2% for prioritized prompt slices, (2) rollback < 15m automated, (3) comm templates + explicit opt-out, (4) billing doc for reserved tenants. I'll own acceptance report.

Priya: Legal: enterprise contracts that reference "pinned" must be exempt unless they sign an exception. SMBs can be auto-enrolled with 14-day notice. We'll produce wording.

Ken: Proposed minimal canary: feature-flagged downgrader (off), 4 internal tenants + 2 low-use customers, 14d shadowing, 7d live staggered taper (90%->50%->0% over 48h), capture 200 sample pre/post outputs. Add KV priming job after each taper stage.

Sam: We'll add alerts: regen latency spike, mismatch-rate for top prompt slices, and a dashboard showing per-tenant before/after diffs. Also implement emergency-freeze API.

Nora: Action items: Ken build flag + taper controller + sample capture (Ken, Thu EOD); Sam add alerts + freeze API + dashboard (Sam, Fri); Ivy produce bench report + comm templates (Ivy, Mon); Priya compile contract exception list and wording (Priya, Mon). I'll schedule 20m review after the live canary week.

ops-bot: CI: feature/cohort-C-downgrader -> staging (dry-run) scheduled 2026-04-15T02:00Z.

Nora: Thanks all. If any red-lines, call them out now. :white_check_mark:
